_comment: The scoring-team strings the league actually published, per season. Seeding validates every
scoring team in club-seed.json against the entry for its season and refuses a string that is
not here, so a league rename fails loudly instead of silently dropping a team from the club
Provenance: the distinct CLUB values across every published list of the season, read from the
local RaceResult corpus (docs/fixtures.md). Team names are league-published and carry no rider
identity. Regenerate the same way for a new season, or once a season is ingested:
select distinct scoring_team from v_individual_result where season_year = ?.
A season with no entry here is an error, not a pass. Add the season deliberately.
